title: Luxe Oasis! Pool, Spa, Golf, Theater & Games!
description:
🌵 Luxe Oasis! Heated/Cooled Pool, Spa, Mini Golf, Gym, Sauna, Game Room & Theater 🎬

Escape to a one-of-a-kind desert retreat in beautiful Mesa, Arizona! This sprawling 6-bedroom, family-friendly home is more than just a vacation rental — it’s an experience. Whether you're looking to relax, entertain, or explore, this home offers the ultimate getaway, including a temperature-controlled pool that can be heated in cooler weather and cooled during hot Arizona summers for year-round comfort.

 The space 
🌟 Property Highlights:

🏡 6 Spacious Bedrooms – Room for everyone, from couples to large families! Designed for comfort, with cozy beds & stylish décor!
🔥 Heated/Cooled Pool & Spa – Enjoy a refreshing dip by day and soak under the stars at night with a temperature-controlled pool for year-round comfort!
⛳ 4-Hole Mini Golf Course – Challenge family and friends to a fun round of putting right in your private backyard!
🌿 Resort-Style Pergola – Relax in the spacious covered lounge or gather for outdoor dining under beautiful café lights!
🎥 Private 9-Seater Theater – Popcorn ready? Enjoy a movie night in style!
🎮 Game Room Fun – Pool, Ping pong, arcade games & more!
💪 Private Gym – Stay on track even on vacation!
🧖‍♂️ Private Sauna – Relax and rejuvenate with a spa-like experience!
🌴 Serene Backyard Paradise – Fire pit, BBQ, lounge seating & outdoor dining under string lights!
♟️ Life-Size Chess Set – Challenge friends & family to a giant chess match! 
🍳 Gourmet Kitchen – Fully stocked & ready for your culinary creations!
⚡ High-Speed Wi-Fi & Smart TVs – Stay connected while you unwind!

🛏️ Dreamy & Spacious Bedrooms for Ultimate Comfort:

✔ Master Suite (Bedroom 1) – King bed with a luxurious en-suite bath, perfect for a relaxing retreat.
✔ Bedroom 2 – King bed, sleek and cozy, ideal for unwinding in style.
✔ Family Suite (Bedroom 3) – Two King beds + crib & changing table, designed for families needing extra space and comfort.
✔ Bedroom 4 – Queen bed, warm and inviting with a serene vibe.
✔ Bedroom 5 – Queen bed, a stylish escape with a plush and cozy feel.
✔ Bunk Room (Bedroom 6) – Two Queen bunk beds, perfect for groups, kids, or a fun sleepover experience! The bunk room has shared space with Game room.

Whether you're looking for privacy, comfort, or a fun group stay, these bedrooms offer premium comfort and relaxation for every guest. 💤✨

🎮 Ultimate Indoor Entertainment & Relaxation 🎬:

Step inside and immerse yourself in non-stop entertainment and comfort:

✔ Game Room – Play over 15,000 arcade games, challenge friends to pool, enjoy board games around a cozy round table, or relive nostalgia on the Pac-Man machine—all surrounded by vibrant LED lighting and a Smart TV.
✔ Private Home Theater – Sink into 9 plush recliners with built-in massagers, grab some fresh popcorn from the popcorn maker, and enjoy an 85-inch LED TV for the ultimate movie night or binge-watching session.
✔ Ping Pong Table – Rally up some friendly competition and test your skills!
✔ Private Home Gym & Sauna – Stay active with a fully equipped fitness area, including free weights & resistance bands, rowing Machine for full-body workouts, and Sauna for post-workout recovery & relaxation

Whether you're here for game nights, fitness, or just pure relaxation, this home offers the perfect balance of fun, relaxation, wellness and unforgettable memories!

🌴 Ultimate Backyard Oasis 🌊🔥

When you're in Arizona, the best place to be is outdoors, soaking in the beautiful weather! That’s why we’ve designed our backyard for the ultimate relaxation and entertainment.

✔ Heated or Cooled Pool & Spa – Enjoy a temperature-controlled pool (depending on the season) with LED string lights and an attached spa for year-round fun.
✔ Poolside Smart TV – Watch your favorite sports or movies while taking a dip, making every swim even more exciting!
✔ 4-Hole Mini Golf Course – Perfect your putting skills or enjoy a little friendly competition with family and friends on your private mini golf course.
✔ Luxury Pergola Retreat – Your own outdoor living room featuring a spacious lounge area and dining table for gathering, relaxing, and making memories together.
✔ Resort-Style Sun Deck – Stretch out on comfortable loungers, soak up the Arizona sunshine, or unwind with a peaceful afternoon by the pool.
✔ Fire Pit Gathering Space – End the day around the fire pit with great conversations, s'mores, and unforgettable Arizona sunsets.
✔ Outdoor BBQ & Dining – Grill your favorite meals and enjoy al fresco dining with plenty of seating for the whole group.
✔ Life-Size Chess Board – Challenge your group to a strategic outdoor match on our giant chess set.

Whether you're swimming, grilling, relaxing, or enjoying a movie under the stars, this backyard is your personal paradise for fun and relaxation! 

📍 Perfect Location!

Tucked in a peaceful upscale neighborhood, yet just minutes from hiking trails, world-class golf courses, shopping, fine dining, and lively nightlife! Explore Scottsdale, Phoenix, or the stunning Arizona landscapes—all within a short drive.

✨ Family-Friendly Attractions:

Golfland Sunsplash: 6 miles (12-minute drive)
Riparian Preserve at Water Ranch: 5 miles (10-minute drive)
Mesa Grande Cultural Park: 8 miles (15-minute drive)
Arizona Museum of Natural History: 8 miles (15-minute drive)
Arizona Splash Water Park: 8 miles (15-minute drive)
Mesa Arts Center: 8.5 miles (15-minute drive)
The SEA LIFE Arizona Aquarium: 17 miles (25-minute drive)
Children's Museum of Phoenix: 20 miles (30-minute drive)

✨ More Than a Stay—It’s an Experience!
Whether you're planning a family reunion, group getaway, or a luxury retreat, this home is built for fun, relaxation, and making unforgettable memories!

🚗 Parking Details:

✔ 5 vehicles can be parked in the driveway
✔ 2 vehicles can be parked directly in front of the home
❌ Do NOT park in front of neighboring homes – Please be respectful of our neighbors!

 Guest access 
🔑 Full Access for Guests!
This isn’t just a stay—it’s your private oasis! Guests have exclusive access to the entire home and all amenities. That means no shared spaces—just you and your group enjoying every luxury this home has to offer!

🛎 Check-In Info:
This property includes self check-in for your convenience. Instructions will be sent 48 hours before arrival.

 Other things to note 
We use Truvi as part of our guest screening process. The primary guest must complete a Truvi application that matches the reservation name, and the background check must be completed within 48 hours of booking, as required by State and City regulations. Your booking is not confirmed until these steps are completed.

A non-refundable $35 damage waiver is also collected via Truvi. This covers accidental damage during your stay and ensures a worry-free experience.

🚨 House Rules – No Parties, No Events, No Loud Music & No Smoking!

We love hosting responsible guests who respect our home and neighbors. Please note:
❌ No Parties or Events or Loud Music – Loud gatherings are strictly prohibited. 
🚭 No Smoking – Smoking is NOT allowed at the property (inside & outside). 
🔇 Respect Quiet Hours (10 PM - 7 AM) – Per Mesa city ordinance.
🐾 All guests and pets staying at the property must be included on the reservation. Unauthorized guests or pets are not permitted and will result in fine or cancellation.

A noise monitoring device (non-recording) will alert if noise level exceeds 75 decibels. Repeated noise alerts will result in early termination of the stay.

For your safety, security cameras are installed ONLY on the outside perimeter of the property. There are no indoor cameras, ensuring your privacy while maintaining security.
